INNER HEAD. [3] [Jamb.]
Neuralgia in left forehead over eye.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Jamb.]
Catarrhal otitis.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Jamb.]
Pimples on face, painful for some distance about them. θ Acne rosaceæ.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Jamb.]
Throat inflamed. θ Catarrhal fever.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Jamb.]
Vomiting.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Jamb.]
Colic.
Inguinal hernia from a fall.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Jamb.]
Offensive, sputtering stool, without much urging.
Scanty, hard stool, after much pressing, with spasmodic closure of anus after evacuation.
Tenesmus.
Bleeding hemorrhoids, copious for days, with great relief of mind and body.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Jamb.]
Tenesmus in bladder, ischuria.
Frequent urination during night.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Jamb.]
Impotence.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Jamb.]
Inflammatory affection of trachea. θ Catarrhal fever.
   

COUGH. [27] [Jamb.]
Cough raises something from pit of throat, but it always gradually falls down again.
Much hawking causing a short cough.
Epidemic cough among children, with coryza, inflammation of eyes and pain in ears.
Catarrh : with much phlegm and rheumatic pains ; with rattling in chest.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Jamb.]
Pain in small of back and in calves.
Aching in sacrum and knees.
   

FEVER. [40] [Jamb.]
Hot hands.
Catarrhal fever ; thirst during chill ; heat before midnight, with affection of trachea, throat, eyes ; sweat when walking.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Jamb.]
Rheumatic pain wanders from place to place, with catarrh.
   

SKIN. [46] [Jamb.]
Comedones.
Acne, with pain extending for some distance around ; the skin disease is < during menstrual period.
Pimples (sore acne) on face.
